accounting_notes: No ledger figures are drawn, but the screen surfaces one accounting-derived eligibility rule as a status value: .status-badge.rejected reads "Rejected — arrears >90 days". That references the >90-day ageing bucket of the resident/unit accounts-receivable ageing (the same bucket the Dues & ledger module would compute against the member's control account). Candidate eligibility therefore depends on the unit's AR ageing at nomination-close date: a household whose 90+ day arrears bucket is non-zero fails vetting. The rejection reason string must be storable verbatim, and the check needs a snapshot date so the ageing that justified the rejection can be reproduced later.
